skill.summary: Generate QuickBooks Online mileage CSV files from Airtable, Outlook, or Google Calendar records using the local qbo-mileage CLI and user-owned credentials.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of qbo-mileage skill.

- Generate QuickBooks Online mileage CSV files from Airtable, Outlook, or Google Calendar data using the local CLI and user credentials.
- Provides commands for dry runs and file generation, with outputs organized by month.
- Includes a review checklist to ensure accuracy of data before confirming CSV readiness.
- Guides users through first-time setup with example config files and setup documentation.
